passages.text: EVERSOURCE ENERGY AND SUBSIDIARIES The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related combined notes included in this combined Annual Report on Form 10-K. References in this combined Annual Report on Form 10-K to "Eversource," the "Company," "we," "us," and "our" refer to Eversource Energy and its consolidated subsidiaries. All per-share amounts are reported on a diluted basis. The consolidated financial statements of Eversource, NSTAR Electric and PSNH and the financial statements of CL&P are herein collectively referred to as the "financial statements." Our discussion of fiscal year 2025 compared to fiscal year 2024 is included herein. Unless expressly stated otherwise, for discussion and analysis of fiscal year 2023 items and of fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023, please refer to Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, in our combined 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K , which is incorporated herein by reference. Refer to the Glossary of Terms included in this combined Annual Report on Form 10-K for abbreviations and acronyms used throughout this Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations . The only common equity securities that are publicly traded are common shares of Eversource. Our earnings discussion includes financial measures that are not recognized under GAAP (non-GAAP) referencing our earnings and EPS excluding losses associated with our previous offshore wind investments, a loss on the pending sale of the Aquarion water distribution business, and a loss on the disposition of land that was initially acquired to construct the Northern Pass Transmission project and was subsequently abandoned. EPS by business is also a non-GAAP financial measure and is calculated by dividing the Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of each business by the weighted average diluted Eversource common shares outstanding for the period. The earnings and EPS of each business do not represent a direct legal interest in the assets and liabilities of such business, but rather represent a direct interest in our assets and liabilities as a whole. We use these non-GAAP financial measures to evaluate and provide details of earnings results by business and to more fully compare and explain our results without including these items. This information is among the primary indicators we use as a basis for evaluating performance and planning and forecasting of future periods. We believe the impacts of the losses associated with our previous offshore wind investments, the loss on the pending sale of the Aquarion water distribution business, and the loss on the disposition of land associated with an abandoned project are not indicative of our ongoing costs and performance. We view these charges as not directly related to the ongoing operations of the business and therefore not an indicator of baseline operating performance. credit_strengths.text: Eversource's regulated electric utility footprint delivers stable, rate-base-driven revenue, with operating margin modestly below the sector median but supported by constructive regulatory recovery. Operating income rose sharply year over year, reflecting cost discipline and rate case outcomes. This earnings quality underpins predictable cash generation for a capital-intensive network business.

Operating cash flow strengthened materially across the trend period, and cash flow to debt sits near the sector median, indicating adequate internal funding relative to peers. This supports the utility's ability to service obligations despite heavy capital spending. The improvement suggests better working capital and regulatory cash recovery.

key_risks.text: The MD&A discloses non-GAAP adjustments for prior offshore wind losses, a pending Aquarion water distribution sale, and an abandoned transmission land disposition. These items signal execution and portfolio-repositioning risk. The pending sale could alter the business mix and cash flow profile, while past offshore wind charges highlight project development risk in a regulated utility.

Debt structure is heavily weighted to long-dated maturities, with the largest portion due after year five, but meaningful near-term maturities exist in the next twelve months and year two. Refinancing risk is manageable given utility access to capital markets, yet the maturity wall requires ongoing market engagement. No short-term borrowings or commercial paper were separately tagged, which may understate total debt.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is below the sector median, and leverage sits above the sector median on a net basis, indicating a highly leveraged profile. Free cash flow is negative after heavy capex, so debt service depends on continued operating cash flow growth and external financing. The indicative financial risk profile is highly leveraged, with limited headroom to the next leverage threshold.

Dividends absorb a substantial share of operating cash flow, leaving little internal cushion for debt reduction. With capex exceeding operating cash flow, the company relies on capital markets to fund both dividends and growth investment. This constrains deleveraging capacity and keeps refinancing risk relevant, though regulated utility access to debt markets remains a mitigant.

overall_credit_view.text: Eversource is a large regulated electric utility with stable revenue and improving operating cash flow, but its credit profile is constrained by high leverage, sub-par interest coverage, and negative free cash flow. The indicative financial risk profile is highly leveraged, with leverage above the sector median and cash flow to debt near the median. Refinancing and regulatory risks warrant monitoring.

Our forward view is that credit metrics will remain pressured by heavy capital investment and shareholder distributions, with limited near-term deleveraging. The pending Aquarion sale and prior offshore wind losses add event risk. We would need to see sustained operating cash flow growth or reduced capex to improve the profile. This is analyst judgement, not a rating.

credit_strengths.text: Eversource受監管的電力公用事業版圖帶來穩定、以費率基礎驅動的收入，營運利潤率略低於行業中位數，但受到建設性監管回收的支持。營運收入按年大幅上升，反映成本紀律及費率個案結果。此盈利質量支撐資本密集型網絡業務的可預測現金產生。
營運現金流在趨勢期內顯著增強，現金流對債務比率接近行業中位數，顯示相對於同業有足夠的內部資金。這支持該公用事業在沉重資本開支下履行義務的能力。改善顯示營運資金及監管現金回收轉好。

key_risks.text: MD&A披露就先前海上風電虧損、待決的Aquarion供水配送出售，以及已放棄的輸電土地處置作出非GAAP調整。這些項目顯示執行及投資組合重新定位風險。待決出售可能改變業務組合及現金流狀況，而過往海上風電費用凸顯受監管公用事業的項目開發風險。
債務結構嚴重偏向長期到期，最大部分在五年後到期，但未來十二個月及第二年存在有意義的近期到期。鑑於公用事業可進入資本市場，再融資風險可控，但到期牆需要持續市場參與。並無短期借款或商業票據被單獨標記，可能低估總債務。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率低於行業中位數，槓桿按淨額計高於行業中位數，顯示高度槓桿狀況。自由現金流在沉重資本開支後為負，因此債務償付依賴持續營運現金流增長及外部融資。指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿，距離下一槓桿門檻的緩衝有限。
股息佔營運現金流相當大份額，留下很少內部緩衝用於減債。由於資本開支超過營運現金流，公司依賴資本市場為股息及增長投資提供資金。這限制去槓桿能力並使再融資風險保持相關，儘管受監管公用事業進入債務市場仍是緩解因素。

overall_credit_view.text: Eversource是一家大型受監管電力公用事業，收入穩定且營運現金流改善，但其信用狀況受高槓桿、低於水平的利息覆蓋率及負自由現金流所限制。指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿，槓桿高於行業中位數，現金流對債務比率接近中位數。再融資及監管風險值得監察。
我們的前瞻觀點是信用指標將因沉重資本投資及股東分派而持續受壓，近期去槓桿有限。待決的Aquarion出售及先前海上風電虧損增加事件風險。我們需要看到持續營運現金流增長或資本開支減少才能改善狀況。此為分析師判斷，並非評級。
